title: route.give
description: Wild Routes (WR2): give the item of a zone's item ball, with the hidden game's own give_item.

keep.description: WR7: false for a dungeon's item, given but not recorded as taken in the save's progress. Default true.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
